purpose: Review a finite issuer human-capital and employee-productivity domain without opening annual-report documents, tables, source rows, candidate values, comparators or returns, and without treating missing source admission as factor ineffectiveness.

repository_evidence.current_profile_headcount_is_not_point_i: Campaign125 already rejects Tushare stock_company employees because the current static row cannot reconstruct 2019-2023 point-in-time states.
repository_evidence.interpretation: Annual-report employee disclosures are a different potential source contract from a current company-profile row, but they remain unavailable for factor definition until their historical document and taxonomy semantics are frozen.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: immutable annual-report document bytes and document identifier for every issuer-period
first public availability timestamp, later revision chain and the exact version usable at each signal time
year-end, opening, closing and average-headcount semantics, including acquisitions, disposals and labor-dispatch workers
employee category taxonomy with non-overlap rules and mappings across issuer wording and annual schema changes
revenue, operating-profit and employee-compensation line identities, units, restatements and denominator scope
missing, undisclosed, not-applicable and genuine-zero semantics
issuer/security mapping and complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest
deterministic parser and acceptance tests that use no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: current_company_profile_employee_count_or_intensity
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Current reported issuer headcount or a scale-normalized transform of it.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign125 already established that the current stock_company row is latest-state data without effective-date history. Reusing it in 2019-2023 would leak later state; scaling the same row would not repair its clock.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_report_revenue_per_average_employee_productivity
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Issuer operating scale generated per historically reported average employee.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted local contract freezes point-in-time annual-report headcount, average-headcount construction, consolidated revenue identity, revisions and complete 2019-2023 coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_report_profit_per_employee_sibling_scale
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Reported issuer earnings generated per employee.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing revenue, operating profit, net profit or another financial numerator against an unadmitted headcount denominator creates a post-concept numerator search. The finite frontier retains one productivity base route and closes sibling scales before values.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_report_research_and_development_personnel_share
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Share of the issuer workforce reported as research-and-development personnel.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The accepted local library has no point-in-time, cross-issuer-stable R&D-personnel numerator and workforce denominator contract with revision and taxonomy handling.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: annual_report_technical_or_education_workforce_composition
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Composition of the issuer workforce by technical role or education category.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Issuer-defined role and education labels, overlapping categories, taxonomy changes and historical document availability are not frozen, so no comparable numeric series may be constructed yet.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: employee_compensation_per_average_employee_or_productivity_joint_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Issuer labor cost per employee, alone or combined with employee productivity.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Cash paid to and for employees is not interchangeable with annual compensation expense, and combining it with an unadmitted average-headcount series or a productivity route would search line identities, denominators and joint operators before source admission.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: The three new states remain deferred at source admission; the three related routes are closed before values to prevent leakage and multiplicity.

next_action: Record all six scientific decisions and the bounded filename-verification failure append-only, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain under the next policy.
